goal.title: Add the API reference tool
criteria: The tool lists every public name and member lacking a doc comment and exits with a failure
With every name documented it exits successfully
The tool writes reference data holding every public name, its signature, description, parameters, return value, errors and members, and the package version
Inherited members appear on a class, and names outside the export lists do not
The tool's dependencies are not dependencies of `xcl-lang`

scope.rule: Change only the files that belong to this item; change nothing that belongs to another task.

verdicts.evidence: api_reference.py:353 exempts every item of kind "attribute" or "constructor" from the check (`if item.kind not in ("attribute", "constructor") and not has_doc_comment(...)`), so a public class attribute with no doc comment is never listed and does not fail the run. The criterion requires every public name and member lacking a doc comment to be listed. The exemption is tested at test_api_reference.py:325-328 (`test_check_needs_no_doc_comment_on_an_attribute_or_constructor`), which asserts exit 0 on an undocumented dataclass field. Module-level constants and functions, methods and properties are checked (api_reference.py:350-357, test_api_reference.py:303-308), so the gap is limited to class attributes, but it is still a gap against the wording. Removing the attribute exemption would meet this criterion. The constructor exemption is defensible because the class doc comment documents it (api_reference.py:499-503).

api_reference.py:596-609 returns 0 when `problems` is empty, and the only failure paths add to `problems`. test_api_reference.py:269-272 (`test_check_passes_on_a_documented_package`) asserts `check(source) == 0` on a fully documented package, and test_api_reference.py:311-314 does the same for a documented constant. The reported 32 passing tests cover these.

api_reference.py:611-613 writes the JSON when `--out` is given. The data holds: the version (`version`, api_reference.py:341-346, 576); every public name as an entry with `id`, `name`, `kind` and `description` (api_reference.py:506-513); `signature` (api_reference.py:510-512, built by function_signature and class_signature at 387-423); `parameters` with name, type, default and description (api_reference.py:531-546); `returns` (api_reference.py:548-555); `raises`, which is the function's error list (api_reference.py:522-524, 557-561); a separate Errors section for exception classes (api_reference.py:232, 283-284, 249-250); and `members` (api_reference.py:527-528). Tests at test_api_reference.py:337-396 and 483-487 check these fields. The error data is keyed as `raises` rather than `errors`, which I read as satisfying the criterion.

Inherited members: Walker._members iterates `cls.all_members` (api_reference.py:313), which includes inherited members, marks them with `inherited_from` (lines 320-321), and places them last (line 328). Test test_api_reference.py:436-447 checks that xcl.Child lists xcl.Child.inherited and that inheritedFrom is xcl._base.Base. Names outside the export lists: Walker only walks `__all__` exports (api_reference.py:266-287, with `xcl.__all__` and module `__all__` lists only), and the EXTRA_MODULES entry is limited to `aio`. Test test_api_reference.py:297-300 and 362-365 check that a name outside `__all__` is ignored and omitted from the data.

/home/nicj/code/github.com/jumppad-labs/xcl/.spektacular/worktrees/20261110084343-9ebf34a1-python-sdk-reference/xcl-python/pyproject.toml:28-33 lists only `protobuf>=5.26` as a dependency, and the test extra at lines 36-43 has only pytest and mypy. goal.title: Run the doc comment check in CI
criteria: A pull request with an undocumented public method fails its required checks, naming the method
The package's own check run passes
A local Makefile target runs the same check

scope.rule: Change only the files that belong to this item; change nothing that belongs to another task.

verdicts.evidence: ci.yml:10-16 runs test.yml on pull_request to main. test.yml:208-224 adds the check-docs job, which runs `python .github/scripts/api_reference.py --check` with no continue-on-error. api_reference.py:609-618 prints `<entry>: no doc comment` for each undocumented public name or member and exits 1. The verification run with Config.close's doc comment removed printed `xcl.Config.close: no doc comment` and exited 1, so the method is named in the failing job's log. test.yml:228-242 (result job) lists check-docs in needs (line 230) and fails unless every needed job is success, so the required `result` check fails. The method is named in the check-docs log, not in the result job's own output, which only echoes the job results.

The check-docs job (test.yml:211-224) installs .github/scripts/requirements-docs.txt (griffe==2.4.1, docutils==0.23) and pytest, runs api_reference.py --check, then runs python -m pytest .github/scripts. It reads the package statically, so it needs no engine or protos. The local run of make check-docs passed (exit 0, 32 tests, no problems). The 20+ xcl/*.py docstring additions in the staged xcl-python diff are what make the check pass. They are outside the listed scope files (test.yml and test_docstrings.py only), which is a scope concern for the implementer. I did not run the hosted CI job itself, so this rests on the local run plus the static job definition. pyproject.toml:77-78 sets testpaths=tests, but an explicit `.github/scripts` path overrides it and no root conftest.py exists, so the pytest step is not affected.

Makefile:56-61 defines check-docs, running `$(PYTHON) .github/scripts/api_reference.py --check` and `$(PYTHON) -m pytest .github/scripts`, the same two commands as the check-docs job in test.yml:222-224. Makefile:63 adds check-docs to .PHONY. Scope concern: the Makefile is not in the goal's listed files (only test.yml and tests/unit/test_docstrings.py), yet this criterion requires a Makefile target, so the scope list does not cover what the criterion asks for.
